<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    bird=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'): bird=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return dict(step=f.step,bird=bird,N=sum(1 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N'))
print("before",snap(current_frame))
res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':33,'col':21}])
print("after",snap(current_frame))
print("board_changed",res.get('board_changed'),"err",res.get('error'))
</parameter>
</function>
